mechanism_narrative: A lower current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the cost of capital for corporations and increases equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.5%, it signals a weakening labor market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5% (or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer credit (RSAFS) indicates a contraction in both housing and consumption demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: The joint signal (both HOUST and RSAFS declining) fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of instances (or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising), higher interest rates compress corporate profit margins and increase discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising), SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances (or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window).

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: Rank IC between PAYEMS and 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (index 2017=100), it signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 (or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and a rise in consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates a stagflationary environment, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The joint signal (INDPRO declining and CPIAUCSL rising) fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of instances (or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (HOUST > 1300 thousand units), elevated housing activity signals an overheating economy, leading to monetary tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions (HOUST > 1300), SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances (or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window).
